# Commands the parser MUST detect, used by tests/test_hook_if_parity.sh to
# assert the gate invariant: anything parse_install_cmd detects must also be
# matched by at least one `if` rule in hooks/hooks.json, or the hook never
# spawns to run the parser and the guard is silently off for that form.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
npm install lodash@4.17.21
npm install lodash
npm install @scope/pkg
npm install lodash@beta
pnpm add react@18.2.0
pnpm add react
yarn add react@18.2.0
yarn add react
bun add react@18.2.0
bun add react
pip install requests==2.31.0
pip install requests
pip3 install requests==2.31.0
pip3 install requests
uv pip install requests==2.31.0
uv pip install requests
uv add requests
poetry add flask@^3.0.0
poetry add flask
cargo add serde
dotnet add package Serilog
dotnet add package Serilog -v 3.1.1
FOO=bar npm install lodash@4.17.21
CFLAGS='-O2 -g' pip install requests==2.31.0
NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' npm install lodash@4.17.21
timeout 30 npm install lodash@4.17.21
timeout 1.5 npm install lodash@4.17.21
nice -n 10 npm install lodash@4.17.21
nohup pip install requests==2.31.0
sudo pip install requests==2.31.0
sudo -u root pip install requests==2.31.0
sudo -i npm install lodash@4.17.21
sudo -S npm install lodash@4.17.21
env -i npm install lodash@4.17.21
xargs -I {} npm install lodash@4.17.21
stdbuf -o 0 cargo add serde
cd app && npm install lodash@4.17.21
echo start ; npm install lodash@4.17.21
